question: Saroja Vaidyanathan received Kalidas Samman for classical dance in _____
solution:
The correct answer is __**2009-10**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saroja Vaidyanathan** received **Kalidas Samman** for classical dance in the year 2009-10.
 
• Kalidas Samman is an Indian award presented annually by the Madhya Pradesh government to individuals who have made significant contributions in the fields of arts, culture, and literature.
 
• **The Madhya Pradesh government** in India grants the Kalidas Samman, an annual arts prize.
 
• The prize bears the name of Kālidāsa, an accomplished writer of ancient India in Classical Sanskrit. In 1980, the Kalidas Samman was first given out.
 
• At first, it was awarded in four fields—classical music, classical dance, theater, and plastic arts—every other year.
 
• The prizes were given out in all four categories most years between 1986–1987 and 2008–2009; after that, it was only given to one recipient annually.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saroja Vaidyanathan** was a renowned Indian dancer, teacher, and advocate of Bharatanatyam.
 
• The Indian government awarded her the Padma Shri in 2002 and the Padma Bhushan in 2013.
 
• The Classical Dances of India, Bharatanatyam - An In-Depth Study, Carnataka Sangeetham, and The Science of Bharatanatyam are just a few of the publications on Bharatanatyam and Carnatic music written by Saroja Vidyanathan.
